question: Who among the following won the 2024 Booker Prize for Fiction for their novel Orbital, which explores themes of isolation, the human condition, and our relationship with Earth?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Samantha Harvey**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Samantha Harvey** is a celebrated British author known for her thought-provoking works of fiction.
 
• She won the **2024 Booker Prize for Fiction** for her novel **"Orbital."**
 
• "Orbital" is a novel that explores **themes of isolation, the human condition, and the relationship between humans and Earth**.
 
• The Booker Prize is one of the most prestigious literary awards globally, highlighting **exceptional fiction works** written in English.
 
• Harvey's writing style is often acclaimed for its **lyrical prose, deep psychological insights, and innovative narratives.**
 
• In "Orbital," Harvey delves into existential themes, offering a **profound exploration of solitude** and the interconnectedness of humanity with the planet.
 
• The novel has been praised for its **unique perspective** and ability to resonate with readers in a time of environmental and social challenges.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sally Rooney**__

 __
 
• **Sally Rooney** is an Irish author known for her novels such as **"Normal People"** and **"Conversations with Friends."**
 
• Her works often explore **relationships, youth, and modern societal issues.**
 
• While Rooney is a widely celebrated author, she did not win the **2024 Booker Prize.**
 
 
 
• **Douglas Stuart**__
 __
 
• **Douglas Stuart** is a Scottish-American writer and the author of the Booker Prize-winning novel **"Shuggie Bain" (2020).**
 
• His works often draw from his upbringing in **working-class Scotland** and explore themes of poverty, addiction, and resilience.
 
• Although a notable figure in contemporary literature, Stuart did not win the **2024 Booker Prize.**
 
 
 
• **Colson Whitehead**__
 
 
• **Colson Whitehead** is an American author known for his Pulitzer Prize-winning novels **"The Underground Railroad"** and **"The Nickel Boys."**
 
• His works often address **themes of race, history, and systemic injustice.**
 
• While a renowned author, Whitehead did not receive the **2024 Booker Prize for Fiction.**
